reviews.title: The app is okay
reviews.text: Overall the app has great qualities and you have many of fun things to do on the app. The moderation on the app is also great. But a big downside to the app is when I FaceTime/call it always echos. 2/10 times it doesn’t echo. When the call is constantly echoing you cannot hear the person you are trying to talk to. That’s why I am rating this 2 stars.

reviews.title: Never updates, usually glitches
reviews.text: This app is great for young kids, but glitches frequently. The most common glitch hides new and old texts on all sides of a chat, saying that the messages couldn’t be displayed. This glitch lasted for two weeks, and keeps coming back. The app “updates” never actually do anything. They don’t change the games, nor any of features, not making it better means to slowly falls apart. Good app for really young kids though.
